paper.title: SlaClip: Gradient Norm Slacks can be Indicator for Adaptive Clipping in DP-SGD

slaclip_upstream.note: The v2 tag identifies the final audited reproduction state; the exact accounting implementation was introduced by the recorded fix commit.

opacus_upstream.note: No Opacus commit was made for the v2 SlaClip repair; the nested SlaClip commit is recorded independently.

declared_engineering_guardrails.note: SlaClip Appendix C's noisy controller signal follows its [0,1] projection; only user-configurable probability parameters are restricted to [0.01,0.99]. AdaClip's noisy-fraction projection is a separately declared engineering guardrail.

protocol_numerics.main_release_count: ceil(N/B)*epochs, passed as an exact integer
protocol_numerics.epsilon_boundary_policy: Complete the full horizon when epsilon(T)<=target; otherwise accept only a proved one-final-release fallback with epsilon(T-1)<=target<epsilon(T)
protocol_numerics.main_k: Eq. (14) floor using final calibrated sigma and actual logical release denominator
protocol_numerics.selection_convention: 10% public stratified holdout, seed 2026; paper does not disclose these values

audit_verification.test_device: CPU regression suite plus RTX 4060 end-to-end MNIST regression

data_provenance_limit.runtime_recording: IMDB tokenized split fingerprints and tokenizer vocabulary SHA-256; Names per-file and manifest SHA-256
data_provenance_limit.claim: No data-level bitwise reproduction claim is made without matching recorded fingerprints.
